name: Rime Bound
text: ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area. While this card is in your play area, the active player cannot apply modifiers to their combat rolls during combat in a system that contains 1 or more of your structures. At the end of the status phase, return this card to the Jötunn player.

name: Althing Barristers
text:
After you vote on an agenda

Cast a number of additional votes equal to the combined influence and resource value of Blot for an outcome of your choice. Then, place 1 of your control tokens on Blot, if able, and return this card to the Brynfolk player.

name: Ratatoskr's Guidance
text: ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area and place 1 Root token on a planet you control. Then, draw 1 card from the exploration deck for each trait that planet has, resolve 1 of those cards, and discard the others. At the start of the status phase, return this card to the Vaettir player.

name: Valkyrie's Favor
text: ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area and attach the Saga token to a non-home, non-legendary planet you control. Gain the Valkyrie Longhouse legendary planet ability card. At the end of the status phase, return the Saga token and this card to the Valdyrjur player.
